# Unity URP Rendering Skills

> Evidence-aware Unity URP render debugging, terrain preservation, static-batch geometry, baseline control and GPU lifecycle lessons for coding agents.

- [Skill](skills/unity-urp-render-debugging/SKILL.md): Start here; load references selectively.
- [Efficient visual iteration](skills/unity-urp-render-debugging/references/efficient-visual-iteration.md): Verify implementer image access, reject weak macro-form early, separate art/preservation and reuse unchanged evidence. Retrospective guidance, no measured speedup.
- [Capture protocol](skills/unity-urp-render-debugging/references/capture-protocol.md): Same-reference comparisons, sorting and first-render shader state.
- [Selection-aware material guards](skills/unity-urp-render-debugging/references/selection-aware-material-guards.md): Current SubShader tags, transient reference material, independent oracle and observable-override limitations.
- [Causal experiments](skills/unity-urp-render-debugging/references/causal-experiments.md): Final clone fidelity, changed occlusion, route-dependent water, transition overlays and reference provenance.
- [Normal metrics and material response](skills/unity-urp-render-debugging/references/normal-metrics-and-material-response.md): Full skew-coordinate gradients, production analytic-plane tests and assignment versus ordinary-RGB contribution.
- [Authored-scene integration](skills/unity-urp-render-debugging/references/authored-scene-integration.md): New-data affine adapter, normal/tangent treatment, dependency-cycle witnesses, separate loading/capture clocks and verified asset reuse.
- [Preservation-first design](skills/unity-urp-render-debugging/references/preservation-first-design.md): Additive versus replacement, hidden-terrain failure, full-slice scope and unproven co-depth overlay coverage.
- [Replay capability checks](skills/unity-urp-render-debugging/references/replay-capability-checks.md): Target identity, positive controls, same-colour writes, batched events and abort-safe cleanup. No native Frame Debugger capability claim.
- [Terrain geometry and visual quality](skills/unity-urp-render-debugging/references/terrain-and-water.md): Impossible skirts, water visibility, winding and mountain composition.
- [Lit redraw and fixture isolation](skills/unity-urp-render-debugging/references/lit-redraw-and-fixture-isolation.md): Lit draw context, non-vacuous identity/active arms, scene-mask baseline controls, bounded readbacks and real unload; actual-scene transfer and memory remain open.
- [GPU and scene lifecycle](skills/unity-urp-render-debugging/references/gpu-and-lifecycle.md): Actual draw-space verification, async ownership and unload orders.
- [Evidence](evidence/case-study.md): Observed results, rejected approaches and unresolved claims.
- [1 November update](evidence/update-2026-11-01.md): Validated material correction and first deterministic bake; asset import and final images still pending.
- [3 November update](evidence/update-2026-11-03.md): Imported resources, corrected route coverage and bounded causal findings; final imagery still unaccepted.
- [4 November update](evidence/update-2026-11-04.md): Two-view additive preservation, no-install repeat control, rejected height trial and source-only overlay limits.
- [4 November afternoon update](evidence/update-2026-11-04-afternoon.md): Actual AA4 overlay rejection, frame/dependency fixes and 72-image INVALID art preview; no preservation acceptance.
- [4 November evening update](evidence/update-2026-11-04-evening.md): Real metric repair, deterministic bakes, limited visual gain and unconfirmed layering hypothesis.
- [5 November update](evidence/update-2026-11-05.md): Actual texture response, zero-test capture error, fourteen-image strict failure/art rejection, corrected feasibility, verified image reads and workload retrospective. New landform outcome still pending.
- [6 November update](evidence/update-2026-11-06.md): Far-only one-view zero residuals, rejected copied draw, native synthetic redraw/lifecycle success under a changed isolated reference; UNKNOWN memory and no real-palace acceptance.
- [Synthetic planning examples](scripts/planning_counterexamples.py): Grid upper bounds, overlapping coverage intervals and perspective texture density; not a scene or GPU certificate.
- [Synthetic skew-gradient example](scripts/skew_gradient_counterexample.py): Invented affine plane showing why normalized skew axes are not orthogonal.
- [Official references](docs/api-references.md): Version-specific Unity APIs.
- [Report checker](scripts/check_capture_report.py): Standard-library evidence checker; not an image analyser.
- [Synthetic geometry examples](scripts/geometry_counterexamples.py): Executable counterexamples; not a scene certificate.
- [Synthetic replay examples](scripts/replay_evidence_counterexamples.py): Last colour change versus writer, irrelevant endpoint changes and partial enable failure; not a Unity debugger.

- [10 November update](evidence/update-2026-11-10.md): Actual-palace original-material identity, later native mesh/render failures, QR source repair and selected-layout crest obstruction; no accepted new terrain or Quest proof.
- [Authored mesh validation](skills/unity-urp-render-debugging/references/authored-mesh-validation.md): Native interchange, UV/normal readbacks, logical/render attribute maps and complete changed-mesh coverage.
- [Bounded terrain solvers](skills/unity-urp-render-debugging/references/bounded-terrain-solvers.md): Early necessary constraints, exact final gates, honest allocation/work reserves and positive-control regressions.
